The Planning Commission is not an advocate for how to improve the city's projects or anyone's projects. And the only time that the Planning Commission works in an advisory role is when there's a legislative item that's brought before about how to change those codes, whether it's the municipal code or the LCP. And in that case, your expertise from seeing all these things comes in very handy, and then you're able to advise the council about how to improve the rules. But your advice is limited to what the rules are. And then when it's a project before you, you are just applying the rules that exist.
